sponsored.t: Authorizes the Centerport Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Centerport Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the collection and use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes
sponsored.sum: Updates provisions regarding the collection and use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes by the Centerport Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association.

sponsored.t: Provides for a fuel tax holiday until the end of the ongoing hostilities with Iran and the reopening of the strait of Hormuz
sponsored.sum: Provides for a fuel tax holiday until the end of the ongoing hostilities with Iran and the reopening of the strait of Hormuz.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Huntington to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands to the Huntington African American Museum
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Huntington to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands to the Huntington African American Museum.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to William E. Peterson
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Babylon, county of Suffolk to William E. Peterson.

sponsored.t: Enacts into law components of legislation relating to the possession and sale of nitrous oxide; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts into law components of legislation relating to the possession and sale of nitrous oxide; criminalizes certain sales and possessions of nitrous oxide; (Part A); regulates the sale of nitrous oxide; (Part B); establishes an education and outreach program relating to nitrous oxide (Part C); criminalizes driving while ability impaired by nitrous oxide (Part D).

sponsored.t: Requires the state comptroller and the attorney general to conduct an annual audit of the office of cannabis management
sponsored.sum: Requires the state comptroller, the attorney general and independent certified public accountants to conduct an annual audit of the office of cannabis management.

sponsored.t: Replaces the word addict or addicts and the word addiction with the words persons with substance use disorder or a variation thereof
sponsored.sum: Replaces certain appearances of the words addict, addicts and addiction with the words person with a substance use disorder, person with a mental health disorder, person with co-occurring disorder, person in recovery, or a variation thereof.

sponsored.t: Requires the electronic cigarette and vaping prevention, awareness and control program be used by all schools
sponsored.sum: Requires the electronic cigarette and vaping prevention, awareness and control program be used by all schools.

sponsored.t: Protects minors online from social media and harmful content
sponsored.sum: Protects minors online from social media and harmful content; establishes penalties for failing to restrict certain minors from certain content.

sponsored.t: Requires hotels and motels to maintain a roster of guests, including their photo identifications, for five years and security footage for ninety days and restricts the use of hourly rates at hotels and motels
sponsored.sum: Requires hotels and motels to maintain a roster of guests, including their photo identifications, for five years and security footage for ninety days; restricts the use of hourly rates at hotels and motels; increases penalties therefor.

sponsored.t: Imposes term limits on members of the legislature
sponsored.sum: Imposes term limits on members of the legislature such that no person can serve in a house of the legislature for more than six consecutive terms.

sponsored.t: Requires five percent of affordable housing units to be offered to veterans
sponsored.sum: Requires five percent of affordable housing units to be offered to veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sale of composting bags
sponsored.sum: Requires composting bags sold within the state be made of paper.

sponsored.t: Requires the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly to provide each member of their respective chamber with any reports issued to them
sponsored.sum: Requires the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly to provide each member of their respective chamber with any reports issued to them.

sponsored.t: Requires a defendant who causes the death of a person with children due to driving while intoxicated or impaired to pay for child support
sponsored.sum: Requires a defendant who causes the death of a person with children due to driving while intoxicated or impaired to pay for child support of such children until they reach the age of 18 years old.

sponsored.t: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "General Colin Powell Thruway"
sponsored.sum: Designates a portion of interstate eighty-seven as the "General Colin Powell Thruway".

sponsored.t: Imposes a term limit on town supervisors
sponsored.sum: Imposes a term limit of four years on town supervisors.

sponsored.t: Requires the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to prohibit the sale of single use plastic and polystyrene foam in state parks
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to prohibit the sale of single use plastic and polystyrene foam in state parks.

sponsored.t: Allows certain parties of releases and covenants involving PFAS to seek contribution from other responsible parties
sponsored.sum: Allows certain parties of releases and covenants involving PFAS to seek contribution from other responsible parties.

sponsored.t: Requires the board of elections to check all registered voter's citizenship and lawful permanent resident status and requires all voters to show government issued identification to vote
sponsored.sum: Requires the board of elections to check all registered voter's citizenship and lawful permanent resident status; requires all voters to show government issued identification to vote.

sponsored.t: Prohibits street takeovers and sideshows
sponsored.sum: Prohibits street takeovers and sideshows; imposes imprisonment of not more than six months, a fine of one thousand dollars, or both such fine and imprisonment for a violation of such prohibition.

sponsored.t: Requires certain businesses in which alcohol or cannabis is consumed have opioid antagonists
sponsored.sum: Requires retail licensees for on-premises consumption of alcohol and adult-use on-site consumption of cannabis licensees have opioid antagonists to be administered to patrons, staff or individuals on premises of such establishment.

sponsored.t: Requires propeller guards on all vessels
sponsored.sum: Requires propeller guards on all vessels.

sponsored.t: Requires the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to prohibit the use or sale of single use plastic straws and beverage stirrers in state parks
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to prohibit the use or sale of single use plastic straws and beverage stirrers in state parks.

sponsored.t: Allows for the denial, suspension or discontinuance of public assistance or care where a person does not participate in three consecutive scheduled interviews with a social services official
sponsored.sum: Allows for the denial, suspension or discontinuance of public assistance or care where a person does not participate in three consecutive scheduled interviews with a social services official.

sponsored.t: Requires all public buildings and all parks, recreation and historic preservation sites have bins for recyclable and compostable materials
sponsored.sum: Requires all public buildings and all parks, recreation and historic preservation sites have bins for recyclable and compostable materials.

sponsored.t: Includes information on if a person previously lived in a nursing home on his or her death certificate
sponsored.sum: Includes information on if a person previously lived in a nursing home on his or her death certificate.

sponsored.t: Requires instruction in owning and operating a business
sponsored.sum: Requires instruction in owning and operating a business including, but not limited to, basic financial literacy necessary for sound financial decision-making, leadership, management, communication, budgeting, savings, credit, debt, insurance, taxation, and other issues associated with owning and operating a business.

sponsored.t: Requires all commercial buildings be retrofitted with motion detectors for controlling lighting
sponsored.sum: Requires all commercial buildings be retrofitted with motion detectors for controlling lighting.

sponsored.t: Prohibits point source pollution in the Long Island Sound and Great South Bay
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain types of pollution in the Long Island Sound and Great South Bay.

sponsored.t: Requires the establishment of electronics and hazardous waste recycling programs in towns within Nassau and Suffolk counties
sponsored.sum: Requires the establishment of electronics and hazardous waste recycling programs in towns within Nassau and Suffolk counties for one year.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the discharge of bilge water into waters of the state
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the discharge of bilge water into waters of the state from any vessel, watercraft, marina or mooring.

sponsored.t: Allows for principals to be remanded into custody for drug treatment where there is a risk of continued substance abuse
sponsored.sum: Allows for principals to be remanded into custody for drug treatment where there is a risk of continued substance abuse or the use of an opioid antagonist was required.

sponsored.t: Requires the state board of elections to conduct a background check on all candidates which appear on a ballot
sponsored.sum: Requires the state board of elections to conduct a background check on all candidates which appear on a ballot.

sponsored.t: Requires the owner of certain sites to establish and maintain an environmental maintenance trust fund
sponsored.sum: Requires the owner of sites where any action is or was taken which may have a significant impact on the environment to establish and maintain an environmental maintenance trust fund.

sponsored.t: Requires the state capitol and the legislative office building conduct active shooter drills
sponsored.sum: Requires the state police to conduct active shooter drills in the state Capitol and the legislative office building.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the public service commission and the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a study on peaker plant electric generating facilities on Long Island
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the public service commission and the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a study on peaker plant electric generating facilities on Long Island.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of criminal justice services to monitor desk appearance tickets and report on the rate which principals appear in court on such tickets
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of criminal justice services to monitor desk appearance tickets and report on the rate which principals appear in court on such tickets.

sponsored.t: Requires certain colleges and universities vet all information displayed on their websites and marketing materials to ensure the information is accurate and impartial
sponsored.sum: Requires certain colleges and universities vet all information displayed on their websites and marketing materials to ensure the information is accurate and impartial.

sponsored.t: Permits facilities to be dually licensed under the office of mental health and the office of addiction services and supports
sponsored.sum: Permits facilities to be dually licensed under the office of mental health and the office of addiction services and supports.

sponsored.t: Requires online products targeted towards children provide certain features to protect child users
sponsored.sum: Requires online products targeted towards children provide features to protect child users including providing screen time controls, prohibiting the promotion of harmful or illegal activities, and removing features which inappropriately amplify the level of engagement a child user has with the online product.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the release of persons convicted of first degree murder
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the release, on parole or otherwise, of persons convicted of first degree murder.

sponsored.t: Requires certain entities when relying on statistics in planning, policy enforcement and reporting be based on the worst-case scenario
sponsored.sum: Requires every department, bureau, board, commission, authority, or any other agency or instrumentality of the state, when relying on statistics in planning, policy enforcement and reporting, to base such planning, policy enforcement and reporting on the worst-case scenario.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of education to establish a uniform dress code across all public high schools
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of education to establish a uniform dress code across all public high schools.

sponsored.t: Prohibits any entity which is contracted to operate the Long Island power authority from lobbying; requires Long Island power authority employees be residents of such authority's service area
sponsored.sum: Prohibits any entity which is contracted to operate the Long Island power authority from lobbying; requires Long Island power authority employees be residents of such authority's service area.

sponsored.t: Requires health care professionals to inquire about the opioid history of certain patients
sponsored.sum: Requires that where a health care professional or professionals require the completion of an allergy checklist or form by the patient, prior to receiving care by such professional or professionals, the checklist or form shall also inquire about the opioid history of such patient.

sponsored.t: Requires choices of a question or proposal printed on a ballot include a brief phrase stating the effect of such choice should such choice win such question or proposal
sponsored.sum: Requires choices of a question or proposal printed on a ballot include a brief phrase stating the effect of such choice should such choice win such question or proposal.

sponsored.t: Directs the state energy planning board to conduct a study on the future of power plants in New York state
sponsored.sum: Directs the state energy planning board to conduct a study and prepare a report on the future of power plants in New York state; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon completion of the study and report.

sponsored.t: Restructures the form of ballot proposals on election ballots, requires the creation and distribution of ballot publicity pamphlets, and creates ballot proposal hearings
sponsored.sum: Restructures the form of ballot proposals on election ballots; requires the creation and distribution of ballot publicity pamphlets; creates ballot proposal hearings.

sponsored.t: Requires residential property owners to register backyard chicken coops
sponsored.sum: Requires residential property owners to register backyard chicken coops for the purposes of containing disease outbreaks affecting such chicken coops.

sponsored.t: Relates to management, development, and funding of the commercial shellfish aquaculture industry
sponsored.sum: Relates to the management, development, and funding of the commercial shellfish aquaculture industry; establishes a director of aquacultural and maricultural resources position in the department of agriculture and markets.

sponsored.t: Creates a crime data clearinghouse within the department of criminal justice services
sponsored.sum: Creates a crime data clearinghouse within the department of criminal justice services; requires such department produces a report on such data.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursement of school districts for expenditures resulting from certain civil action settlements or jury awards
sponsored.sum: Relates to reimbursement of school districts for expenditures resulting from certain civil action settlements or jury awards related to child sex offenses if there was a monetary judgement issued or settlement agreement, the school district has no applicable insurance and the settlement or jury award would put a substantial financial burden on the school district.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of coordinated petit larceny, permits a principal to be eligible to be held on bail for coordinated petit larceny, and creates a public service campaign on larceny
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of coordinated petit larceny; permits a principal to be eligible to be held on bail for coordinated petit larceny; directs the division of criminal justice services to conduct a public awareness campaign on larceny.

sponsored.t: Allows for the taking of deer with a crossbow in Suffolk county
sponsored.sum: Allows for the taking of deer with a crossbow in Suffolk county.

sponsored.t: Permits assistant district attorneys to live anywhere within the state
sponsored.sum: Permits assistant district attorneys to live anywhere within the state.

sponsored.t: Increases security on digital submissions to the state by requiring the use of verified accounts and multi-factor authorization
sponsored.sum: Increases security on digital submissions to the state by requiring the use of verified accounts and multi-factor authorization.

sponsored.t: Establishes the high school peer mentoring pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the high school peer mentoring pilot program.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York state waste recycling and reduction act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York state waste recycling and reduction act" to require each commercial building in the state to recycle paper products and single-use plastic products produced or used on site.

sponsored.t: Requires cardiopulmonary resuscitation instruction as a part of the health education curriculum in all senior high schools
sponsored.sum: Requires cardiopulmonary resuscitation instruction as a part of the health education curriculum in all senior high schools.

sponsored.t: Increases penalties relating to the underage use of cannabis
sponsored.sum: Adds to the penalties for the underage use of cannabis the office of cannabis management contacting the person's parents and/or guardians and such person and their parents and/or guardians attending a cannabis diversion program.

sponsored.t: Requires the use of verified accounts and multi-factor authorization before state funds can be distributed digitally
sponsored.sum: Requires the use of verified accounts and multi-factor authorization before state funds can be distributed digitally.

sponsored.t: Decreases the distance from the high water mark certain lands under water of Gardiner's and Peconic bays have to be to be ceded to a county
sponsored.sum: Decreases the distance from the high water mark certain lands under water of Gardiner's and Peconic bays have to be ceded to a county from one thousand feet to five hundred feet.

sponsored.t: Implements oral fluid tests
sponsored.sum: Implements oral fluid tests which tests a person's saliva for the presence of cannabis.

sponsored.t: Establishes a separate states working group to conduct a study on Long Island statehood
sponsored.sum: Establishes a separate states working group to conduct a study on Long Island statehood which includes a cost benefit analysis on Long Island statehood.

sponsored.t: Requires manufacturers and dealers of liquid nicotine products accept used liquid nicotine products for recycling and creates the crime of improper disposal of a liquid nicotine product
sponsored.sum: Requires manufacturers and dealers of liquid nicotine products accept used liquid nicotine products for recycling; creates the crime of improper disposal of a liquid nicotine product.

sponsored.t: Requires schools to include instruction on the prevention of co-occurring disorders as an integral part of their health education programs
sponsored.sum: Requires schools to include instruction on the prevention of co-occurring disorders as an integral part of their health education programs.

sponsored.t: Requires buildings place building identification at least three feet above ground level where plainly visible and legible from the street or road fronting the property
sponsored.sum: Requires the state fire prevention and building code council to adopt uniform fire prevention and building code standards requiring buildings have their address numbers, building numbers, or approved building identification placed at least three feet above ground level where plainly visible and legible from the street or road fronting the property.

sponsored.t: Requires public schools to start no earlier than eight thirty a.m. and that no public high school within the state shall start before an elementary school starts within the same school district
sponsored.sum: Requires public schools to start no earlier than eight thirty a.m. and that no public high school within the state shall start before an elementary school starts within the same school district.

sponsored.t: Requires libraries have charging stations for plug-in electric vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires public libraries have charging stations for plug-in electric vehicles.

sponsored.t: Prevents the price gouging of water at places of entertainment
sponsored.sum: Prevents the price gouging of water at places of entertainment by requiring places of entertainment provide conscionably priced bottled or tap water at a price not to exceed one dollar per sixteen and nine tenths ounces.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "3000 by '30 act"
sponsored.sum: Provides loan forgiveness for social workers who work within New York state for five years.

sponsored.t: Prohibits students from possessing cellphones during classroom instruction
sponsored.sum: Prohibits students from possessing cellphones during classroom instruction.

sponsored.t: Requires a certain percentage of affordable housing funded by the state be used for veterans and people with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Requires affordable housing funded by the state be used for veterans and people with disabilities, with each group receiving five percent of such affordable housing.

sponsored.t: Requires the distribution of an information card or sheet with Schedule II opioids
sponsored.sum: Requires the distribution of an information card or sheet with Schedule II opioids.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of education to establish model codes of conduct on school property regarding cellphone use
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of education to establish model codes of conduct on school property regarding cellphone use.

sponsored.t: Relates to contracts entered into by the Long Island Power Authority for emergency goods and services
sponsored.sum: Relates to contracts entered into by the Long Island Power Authority for emergency goods and services.

sponsored.t: Directs the division of criminal justice services to expand the crimes against revenue program to all counties within the state
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of criminal justice services to include in the crimes against revenue program each county within the state and provide funding to each such county.

sponsored.t: Requires persons prescribing or dispensing opioids to counsel patients about the potential addictive properties of opioids
sponsored.sum: Requires practitioners to provide counselling to patients about the potential addictive properties of opioids prior to prescribing such medications; requires pharmacists to provide counselling to patients about the potential addictive properties of opioids at the time a prescription for opioids is filled.

sponsored.t: Requires certain municipal positions undergo continuing legal education courses in ethics
sponsored.sum: Requires certain municipal positions undergo continuing legal education courses in ethics and the format in which such courses may be completed.

sponsored.t: Changes the timing of certain discovery requirements to sixty days prior to trial
sponsored.sum: Changes the timing of certain discovery requirements to sixty days prior to trial.

sponsored.t: Relates to floor area ratio requirements for buildings on farms
sponsored.sum: Requires floor area ratio requirements for buildings on farms to be no more restrictive than state requirements for zoning purposes.

sponsored.t: Improves public service commission oversight of the Long Island power authority; repealer
sponsored.sum: Improves public service commission oversight of the Long Island power authority.

sponsored.t: Establishes a real property tax exemption for spouses of police officers killed in the line of duty
sponsored.sum: Establishes a real property tax exemption for the primary residences of spouses of police officers killed in the line of duty.

sponsored.t: Renames boards of cooperative educational services to NY polytechnical institutes
sponsored.sum: Renames boards of cooperative educational services to NY polytechnical institutes.

sponsored.t: Establishes the felony of aggressive driving
sponsored.sum: Establishes the felony of aggressive driving.

sponsored.t: Requires all trains and stations operated by the Long Island Rail Road and the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company have automated external defibrillators
sponsored.sum: Requires all trains and stations operated by the Long Island Rail Road and the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company have automated external defibrillators as part of their medical emergency services program.

sponsored.t: Increases the required number of instructional days in a school year to two hundred
sponsored.sum: Increases the required number of instructional days in a school year to two hundred.

sponsored.t: Establishes a co-occurring disorders patient bill of rights; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes a co-occurring disorders patient bill of rights to be implemented by various agencies; requires a five-year plan for implementing such bill of rights.

sponsored.t: Establishes a co-occurring disorders patient bill of rights
sponsored.sum: Establishes a co-occurring disorders patient bill of rights to be implemented by various agencies.

sponsored.t: Prohibits any governmental entity from outsourcing any function which can be performed by such entity
sponsored.sum: Prohibits any governmental entity from outsourcing any function which can be performed by such entity except where specifically authorized by law.

sponsored.t: Requires electric vehicle charging stations and electric vehicle ready parking spaces on state properties
sponsored.sum: Requires electric vehicle charging stations and electric vehicle ready parking spaces on certain state properties.

sponsored.t: Establishes a town of Huntington deer management pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a town of Huntington deer management pilot program.

sponsored.t: Requires all school employees complete student mental wellness training
sponsored.sum: Requires all school employees complete student mental wellness training on identifying signs and symptoms of mental health issues, eating disorders, behavioral health disorders, and substance use disorders, the use of evidence-based training programs including, but not limited to, mental health first aid or core elements of such programs to the extent practicable, and safe de-escalation of crisis situations.

sponsored.t: Includes all FDA approved forms and doses of Naloxone as opioid antagonists in the state definition of opioid antagonists
sponsored.sum: Includes all FDA approved forms and doses of Naloxone as opioid antagonists in the state definition of opioid antagonists; requires the department of health to approve all forms and doses of Naloxone approved by the FDA as opioid antagonists.

sponsored.t: Prohibits vapor products dealer storefronts, cannabis retail licensee storefronts, and adult-use on-site cannabis consumption licenses in certain locations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits vapor products dealer storefronts, cannabis retail licensee storefronts, and adult-use on-site cannabis consumption licenses within one mile of school grounds, houses of worship, parks, and playgrounds, and in mixed-use buildings in which there are one or more residences; requires the revocation of the certificate of occupancy of vapor products dealer storefronts, cannabis retail licensee storefronts, and premises with an adult-use on-site consumption license within one mile of school grounds, houses of worship, parks, and playgrounds, and in mixed-use buildings in which there are one or more residences, in accordance with a specified schedule.

sponsored.t: Expands mechanic's liens on real property to include attorneys, engineers, and architects
sponsored.sum: Expands mechanic's liens on real property to include certain legal work for attorneys and design work for engineers and architects which relates to permits and zoning approvals for such real property.

sponsored.t: Designates April eighth as Co-Occurring Disorders Awareness Day
sponsored.sum: Designates April eighth as "Co-Occurring Disorders Awareness Day".

sponsored.t: Prohibits advertisements on television and radio of cannabis and cannabis products
sponsored.sum: Prohibits advertisements on television and radio of cannabis and cannabis products subject to a $5000 fine and license or registration revocation after notice and an opportunity to be heard.

sponsored.t: Increases the efficiency of the disbursement of appropriations and grants
sponsored.sum: Increases the efficiency of the disbursement of appropriations and grants by requiring they be paid using electronic transfer with dual verification methods.

sponsored.t: Requires the school of a child who has their parent or guardian arrested or whose house has been visited by police be informed of such arrest or visit and the school establish procedures regarding such instances
sponsored.sum: Requires the school of a child who has their parent, guardian, or other person legally charged with the care or custody of such child arrested or whose house has been visited by police be informed of such arrest or visitation and the school establish procedures to best help such child.

sponsored.t: Increases penalties for assaulting, stalking, or harassing an elected official
sponsored.sum: Increases penalties for assaulting, stalking, or harassing an elected official.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state energy resource and development authority to conduct a feasibility study on installing solar panels and other renewable energy systems along state highways
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state energy resource and development authority, in collaboration with the New York state thruway authority, the department of transportation, and the New York power authority, to conduct a feasibility study on installing solar panels and other renewable energy systems along state highways and to submit a report relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Requires search engines inform users when showing information which was generated using artificial intelligence
sponsored.sum: Requires search engines inform users when showing information which was generated using artificial intelligence.

sponsored.t: Requires disclosure of use of generative artificial intelligence to clients, criminal defendants, and the court
sponsored.sum: Requires disclosure of use of generative artificial intelligence to clients, criminal defendants, and the court.

sponsored.t: Requires slow-moving traffic, trucks, buses, and other certain vehicles use the right two lanes of a multilane roadway
sponsored.sum: Requires slow-moving traffic, trucks, buses, and other certain vehicles use the right two lanes of a multilane roadway and requires all lanes other than the right most two lanes on a multilane highway to be marked with "NO TRUCKS OR BUSES".

sponsored.t: Requires the superintendent of financial services to audit certain reports to ensure such insurers are in full compliance with federal and state mental health and substance use disorder parity requirements
sponsored.sum: Requires the superintendent of financial services to audit certain reports to ensure such insurers are in full compliance with federal and state mental health and substance use disorder parity requirements.

sponsored.t: Directs the state comptroller to conduct an audit of the department of financial services to ensure compliance with federal and state requirements
sponsored.sum: Directs the state comptroller to conduct an audit of the department of financial services to ensure the agency is meeting its responsibility to evaluate and assess insurer compliance with federal and state mental health and substance use disorder parity requirements.

sponsored.t: Directs the state comptroller to conduct an audit of the department of health and other agencies to ensure compliance with federal and state requirements
sponsored.sum: Directs the state comptroller to conduct an audit of the department of health and other agencies to ensure that the agency meets its responsibilities to review and assess Medicaid managed care organizations for compliance with federal and state requirements to maintain adequate health care providers within network, and to meet mental health and substance use disorder parity requirements.
